title: `merge --fix-check` records a fix check after a notes-only commit
why: Incident #1515 (coordinator, 15:03 CST): a fix check could not be recorded after a notes-only commit on the PR.
note: Red test first. Scope (lane, 15:04 CST): `merge --fix-check` in merge/merge.py may record a fix check when every commit after the newest earlier record's Head touches only record or notes files (the record kinds in lint/layout.json); any other later commit still refuses. Seen on lane verdict-pipe-masks-exit, PR #1515, 15:02 CST. Stacks on review-fix-check-round (#1440). Topic review-rounds.
